question: My UK visitor visa was refused. What exactly went wrong, and should I reapply or challenge the decision?
private_situation: Samuel Mensah from Accra, a clerk at Tema Harbour Logistics, had his UK Standard Visitor visa refused because his bank statements showed an unexplained large deposit and his employment letter was not verified, while planning to visit his brother Kofi Asante.
answer_rubric: Explains the refusal grounds in the letter (unexplained funds, genuine visitor doubts, employment evidence)
States that there is no right of appeal for visitor visas and that options are reapplying or judicial review in limited cases
Lists concrete evidence to strengthen a new application (source of funds, payslips, employer verification, sponsor documents, itinerary)
Advises addressing every refusal point explicitly and considering professional advice
